title: Capture on any screen, and copy several captures at once.
notes: More than one screen: the capture overlay follows the mouse, so move it to the screen you want and select there. Screen asks which screen to take: click the one you want.
Library: select several captures (⌘-click or Shift-click) and copy them all with Copy, the right-click menu or ⌘C / Ctrl+C. They paste into chats, emails and folders as files.
New image: clearer sizes, width and height boxes you can type in, and a padlock that keeps the ratio.
Guides: the page settings fit their panel again, and Marker size no longer hides behind its buttons.
